{{Quote|You chose the wrong house to rob, fool!|Big Poppa in [[A Home in the Hills]].}}
'''Big Poppa''' is a minor character and [[antagonist]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

He is voiced by [[Jeff Bennett]].

==History==
===Background===
Big Poppa was a [[Drug Dealers|drug dealer]] affiliated with the [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Los Santos Vagos]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
Big Poppa takes [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg's]] [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] in exchange for [[drugs]]. During the mission [[A Home in the Hills]], Madd Dogg tells [[Carl Johnson]] and [[San Fierro Triads|San Fierro Triad]] gang members about the events, saying that he was "powerless" against Big Poppa. Carl and the Triads assault and re-take the house. Carl then kills the fleeing Big Poppa.

==Character==
===Appearance===
Like [[Little Weasel]], [[Kane]], and [[Freddy (GTA San Andreas)|Freddy]], Big Poppa does not have a unique character model, simply appearing with a generic Vagos model.

==Mission Appearances==
*[[A Home in the Hills]] <small>(Killed)</small>

==Trivia==
*Big Poppa is named after the late rapper {{WP|The Notorious B.I.G.}}'s song "{{WP|Big Poppa}}" ([[1994]]).
**The song samples "Between The Sheets", which plays on [[Bounce FM]].
**Biggie Smalls referred to himself as "Big Poppa" or simply "Poppa".
